```go
package ledger

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"

	"strings"

// Entry represents a single ledger entry.
type Entry struct {
	Date        string // "YYYY-MM-DD"
	Description string
	Change      int // in cents
}

// FormatLedger renders the given entries as a formatted ledger table for the
// supplied currency and locale.
func FormatLedger(currency string, locale string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {
	if err := validate(currency, locale); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	sorted := make([]Entry, len(entries))
	copy(sorted, entries)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {
		if sorted[i].Date != sorted[j].Date {
			return sorted[i].Date < sorted[j].Date
		}
		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {
			return sorted[i].Description < sorted[j].Description
		}
		return sorted[i].Change < sorted[j].Change
	})

	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString(locale.header())
	for _, e := range sorted {
		line, err := formatLine(currency, locale, e)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		sb.WriteString(line)
	}
	return sb.String(), nil
}
```

```go
func FormatLedger(currency string, loc string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {

		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {

		}

	}
```
